mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a contraction in aggregate demand, triggering equity sell-offs as revenue growth expectations fall, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply chain disruption regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals reduced output capacity, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply chain disruption regimes, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 105.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed Fed rate cuts that increase equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime, a monthly housing starts increase above 1300.0 thousand units (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, boosting retail sales and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In housing market boom regimes, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1300.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.
